hint.kilojouleText: Many bike computers and smartwatches show kilojoules (kJ) burned alongside calories. Handy coincidence: 1 kcal is technically 4.184 kJ, but since your body only converts roughly 20–25% of food energy into actual pedaling power, the kJ number on your head unit lines up surprisingly closely with the kcal you just earned back. Rule of thumb: kJ on the display ≈ kcal you rode off.

footer.disclaimer: All figures are rough estimates for fun, not sports-medical advice.
